Pathology Confidence Score: 98.4%
🌱 Organic & Biological Treatment Protocol:

Spray fermented sour buttermilk (खट्टी छाछ) 5L diluted in 100L water per acre with 0.5% neem oil.

🧪 Chemical Spray Prescription (CIBRC Approved):

Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 200 ml or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 250 ml in 200 liters of water per acre.

200 ml / acre in 200L water
